content: We train and evaluate the Show&Tell and LRCN1u models on the ShapeWorldICE datasets. Here we discuss in detail the diagnostic results of these experiments. During training, we periodically record model output on the test images, to be able to analyze the development of our evaluation metrics throughout the process. We also compute BLEU-4 scores and SPICE scores of generated captions for comparison, using 10 reference captions per test image.
